summary: The Lambda-chain induction the task asks for is real, small, and now PROVED sorry-free (three cases, via the source's own Lemma 4.7(ii)+(iv) recipe; compiled with zero diagnostics). But discharging Soundness.lean:1315 is blocked by three pre-existing defects, each established with Lean-verified evidence: (D1) Lemma 4.7(ii) was never landed - the module docstring's claim that page 10 displays 4.7(i) and (ii) with 'literally the same visible formula' is refuted by a direct pdftotext -layout render, and 4.7(ii) is the exact ingredient the source names for this induction; (D2) InputCtx.outputPruning (= Gamma' ++ Lambda) is off by one nesting level when ctx.Lambda = [], which makes nested_sound_impL FALSE as stated, not merely unproved (counterexample: ctx = <[C], [], P>, C := A, B := bot - both premises Lean-proved derivable, conclusion A -> box((A -> bot) -> P) fails in a 2-world classical S5 model and every CS5 theorem is classically S5-valid); (D3) nested_sound is non-exhaustive (missing the NestedProof.cut case), so lake build of the target module currently FAILS on a clean tree - the baseline is RED, contradicting the task brief's 'lake build green' premise. With D1 and D2 repaired, the complete sorry-free discharge of the rule was assembled and compiled end-to-end during research. Eight existing declarations are reused; exactly one new definition-level change is needed (a one-line repair to outputPruning). No new axioms, no sorry deferral.

blockers.title: Lemma 4.7(ii) is missing from Soundness.lean
blockers.detail: page 10: (i) is ((D imp A) and (D imp B)) imp (D imp C); (ii) is ((D imp A) and (D and B)) imp (D and C). These differ. lemma4_7_i_ii (Soundness.lean:503) covers (i) only. The docstring paragraph at Soundness.lean:35-45 asserting duplication must be corrected. Resolution: land lemma4_7_ii (proved sorry-free during research, ~20 lines, structural clone of lemma4_7_i_ii).

blockers.title: InputCtx.outputPruning is defective at ctx.Lambda = [] - the theorem is refutable as stated
blockers.detail: Context.lean:188. InputCtx.fillLhs places the hole inside an extra .box; Gamma' ++ Lambda does not account for it when Lambda = []. Hole-depth table verified by rfl at |Lambda| = 0,1,2. Fix: outputPruning ctx := ctx.Gamma' ++ (ctx.Lambda.headD NestedLhs.empty :: ctx.Lambda.tail) - identity on non-empty Lambda, and on Lambda = [] it reproduces the source's own Example 2.1 decomposition. Corroborating evidence: Translation.lean:300's Lambda = []-restricted tBox bridge collapses to reflexivity under the fix, i.e. the tBox was papering over exactly this gap. This is a scope EXPANSION beyond the task brief and the plan must own it.

blockers.title: Baseline lake build is RED - nested_sound is missing the NestedProof.cut case
blockers.detail: lake build Cslib.Logics.Modal.Metalogic.Constructive.Nested.Soundness fails: '1329:2: Missing cases: _, (NestedProof.cut (InputCtx.mk _ _ _) _ _ _)'. Committed state at 88b198bf; Cslib/ working tree clean. The task's 'lake build green' invariant is therefore unreachable by discharging impL alone. Resolution path sized in the report: reuse the repaired impL argument with B := A plus 'A imp A is always provable' (the source's own one-liner), routed through the already-landed InputCtx.fillLhs_fm_antitone, plus one small bridging induction OutputCtx.fillLhs_empty_imp_fillEmpty. This is the one piece not yet compiled.
